nl: Rename the field ID of the Go struct store.Order to Number. Keep the JSON tag "id", format the struct as gofmt does (aligned columns) and update the struct literal in the test.
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('internal/store/store.go'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('\tID       int     `json:"id"`\n\tCustomer string  `json:"customer"`\n\tTotal    float64 `json:"total"`\n') == 1, 'internal/store/store.go'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('\tID       int     `json:"id"`\n\tCustomer string  `json:"customer"`\n\tTotal    float64 `json:"total"`\n', '\tNumber   int     `json:"id"`\n\tCustomer string  `json:"customer"`\n\tTotal    float64 `json:"total"`\n').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('internal/store/store_test.go'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('ID: 1') == 1, 'internal/store/store_test.go'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('ID: 1', 'Number: 1').encode())
EOF
